g.text: CPU interface, pin-out from the WPC schematic manual 16-9834.2. J113: 7 /LMP ROW, 8 /LMP COL, 9 /SOL 2 (sol 17-24), 10 /SOL 4 (sol 1-8), 11 /SOL 3 (sol 9-16),

g.desc: CPU interface, pin-out from the WPC schematic manual 16-9834.2. J113: 7 /LMP ROW, 8 /LMP COL, 9 /SOL 2 (sol 17-24), 10 /SOL 4 (sol 1-8), 11 /SOL 3 (sol 9-16),

g.text: 12 /SOL 1 (sol 25-28), 13 /TRIAC, 15..29 odd = /D7../D0, 31 BLANKING (HIGH = every latch tri-stated, open-collector from the CPU, pulled up here),

g.desc: 12 /SOL 1 (sol 25-28), 13 /TRIAC, 15..29 odd = /D7../D0, 31 BLANKING (HIGH = every latch tri-stated, open-collector from the CPU, pulled up here),

g.text: 34 ZERO CROSS to the CPU; 1/3/5/32/33 (flipper-opto sense of the -1 relay board) and 2 are N/C on the A-12697-3; other even pins = ground.

g.desc: 34 ZERO CROSS to the CPU; 1/3/5/32/33 (flipper-opto sense of the -1 relay board) and 2 are N/C on the A-12697-3; other even pins = ground.

g.text: The CPU board drives the data through a 74LS240, so the ribbon data is ACTIVE LOW: U9 (74HCT240) inverts it and every latch then takes the

g.desc: The CPU board drives the data through a 74LS240, so the ribbon data is ACTIVE LOW: U9 (74HCT240) inverts it and every latch then takes the

g.text: true bus (register bit = 1 -> output ON, as PinMAME / FreeWPC write it). BLANKING tri-states every 74HCT574 (gate pull-downs -> all OFF) and pulls

g.desc: true bus (register bit = 1 -> output ON, as PinMAME / FreeWPC write it). BLANKING tri-states every 74HCT574 (gate pull-downs -> all OFF) and pulls

g.text: the lamp-row 1.4 V reference low. Zero-cross: the F113-fused leg of the 9 VAC winding is sampled through R197 10K / R254 1.5K / C21 (R198 DNP)

g.desc: the lamp-row 1.4 V reference low. Zero-cross: the F113-fused leg of the 9 VAC winding is sampled through R197 10K / R254 1.5K / C21 (R198 DNP)

g.text: into the + input of U6A against the 0.26 V reference on - -> ZERO CROSS is HIGH while that leg is positive: a 60 Hz square wave (~7.7 ms high)

g.desc: into the + input of U6A against the 0.26 V reference on - -> ZERO CROSS is HIGH while that leg is positive: a 60 Hz square wave (~7.7 ms high)

g.text: with one edge per mains zero crossing - the waveform of the A-12697 (U6A pin 7 +, D38 sample; a real TP4 measures ~8.1 ms high pulses).

g.desc: with one edge per mains zero crossing - the waveform of the A-12697 (U6A pin 7 +, D38 sample; a real TP4 measures ~8.1 ms high pulses).
